instructions: Complete the notes below. Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
stem_block:
BEHAVIOURAL ECONOMICS

The standard model
- a decision-maker whose preferences never change
- someone who holds every piece of information needed
- attention that is (31) ........

Reference points
- an outcome is read as a gain or a loss from where we happen to be
- the ratio of a loss to a gain of the same size is nearer (32) ........ than the figure usually quoted

Framing
- a rail operator put one punctuality statistic on its leaflets in two different wordings
- a month later the two versions differed sharply in the number of (33) ........

Defaults
- form needed in order to join a workplace savings scheme: about one in four took part
- automatic enrolment, form needed in order to leave: about (34) ........ took part

Why a default works
- effort: even a trivial obstacle reduces the numbers
- the default quietly says what is normal
- (35) ........: the intention to act is never carried out

Present bias
- staff agree now to save more, but the extra money is only taken from the (36) ........

items.evidence: The standard model assumes a decision-maker with stable preferences, complete information and unlimited attention.
items.explanation: The three assumptions of the standard model are listed; the third one left blank in the notes is unlimited attention.

items.prompt: - the ratio of a loss to a gain of the same size is nearer (32) ........ than the figure usually quoted
items.evidence: The careful estimates actually put it closer to two to one
items.explanation: The lecturer corrects the commonly quoted ratio of three to one: careful estimates are closer to two to one.

items.prompt: - a month later the two versions differed sharply in the number of (33) ........
items.evidence: the second version produced nearly twice as many complaints over the following month
items.explanation: The two leaflets carried identical information — nine in ten trains arrive on time, or one in ten trains is delayed — but the second wording produced nearly twice as many complaints over the following month.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: - the negative version almost doubled the number of (33) ........ in the month that followed
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Senaryo gösterilmeden 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: 'olumsuz sürüm ertesi ay (33) sayısını neredeyse iki katına çıkardı' çerçevesi olumsuz bir metnin artırabileceği tek sayılabilir şeyi bırakıyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Karşıtlık çerçeveden sese taşındı: hangi sürümün hangi yönde etki ettiği ve 'iki katı' bilgisi artık yalnız konuşmada. Boşluk 'iki sürüm arasında farklılaşan sayı' diyor, şikâyet dışında yolcu / bilet / iade gibi adaylar da ayakta. Cevap, answer_point_id ve turn_index değişmedi.

items.flag_reason: YENIDEN ISARETLENDI 2026-08-18 (yazim turu, olcumle): cerceve_sozu kanali KAPANDI ('olumsuz surum ... iki katina cikardi' belirlenimi kaldirildi, karsitlik sese tasindi) ve alti sessiz turun ikisinde artik 'passengers' geldi. Ama 'complaints' hala en olasi tahmin (6 turun 4'u): olumsuz cerceveli bir metnin artirabilecegi sayilabilir tek sey sikayettir - bu GENEL KULTUR kanali. Kalici cozum bosluga senaryodaki baska bir olguyu anahtarlamak, yani cevabi degistirmek; senaryo isi, genel_kultur turuna birakildi.

items.prompt: - automatic enrolment, form needed in order to leave: about (34) ........ took part
items.evidence: participation rose to roughly nine in ten
items.explanation: Under automatic enrolment, participation rises to nine in ten; the claim from that period that nobody opted out is not correct.

items.prompt: - (35) ........: the intention to act is never carried out
items.evidence: The third is delay. Most people intend to deal with the form, and go on intending it.
items.explanation: The third reason the default works is delay: people intend to fill in the form, but the intention is never carried out.

items.prompt: - staff agree now to save more, but the extra money is only taken from the (36) ........
items.evidence: with the extra contribution starting only when their next pay rise arrives
items.explanation: To get around present bias, the extra contribution is taken not from current pay but starting from the next pay rise.
items.flag_reason: Senaryo gösterilmeden 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: 'personel daha çok biriktirmeyi kabul ediyor ama fazla para yalnız (36) alınıyor' davranışsal iktisadın bilinen 'Save More Tomorrow' düzeneği, ek katkı bir sonraki zamdan kesilir.
